entities.summary: Mari Yamazaki  is a Japanese manga artist known for her seinen comedy manga Thermae Romae. She was born in Tokyo, but spent many years in Italy and now lives in Chicago. Between 2003 and 2013 she lived in Syria, Portugal and the United States.
